properties.description: Chicago 311 service requests of type "Rodent Baiting/Rat Complaint" created in 2023 (server-side filtered), a second point process for bivariate / Knox stories.
storyNotes: Busiest tract (index 198) logged 455 complaints; complaint counts reflect reporting propensity as well as rats.
Complaints are residential-address based and are good for testing co-location with other point processes such as wildlife sightings (cross-K, bivariate Moran) at tract level.
